android.desc:
Create scripts for taps, swipes, delays, image matching, pixel checks, OCR, text transforms, variables, loops, conditions, shortcuts, and reusable routines. ScriptTap is built for people who want flexible automation without root access or desktop-only tools.

Run scripts directly from ScriptTap, launch enabled scripts from Android shortcuts, or call them from compatible automation apps. This makes ScriptTap useful as both a standalone automation tool and a visual action engine for larger Android workflows.

Use ScriptTap to automate repeated actions, build screen-aware workflows, and organize larger automation setups with a visual editor. AI-assisted tools can also help draft scripts, explain functions, and turn automation ideas into working ScriptTap flows.

Core features:
• Visual script editor for tap, swipe, wait, loop, logic, screen-read, and device actions
• Image, pixel, UI element, and OCR-based screen detection
• Routines that can run scripts from triggers such as time, app activity, or screen conditions
• Android shortcuts for launching enabled scripts directly
• Compatible automation-app launch support for enabled ScriptTap scripts
• AI Builder support for creating and improving automation scripts
• Local-first script control with optional account and cloud features

ScriptTap is built to scale from a simple clicker macro to advanced screen-aware workflow automation, while staying easy to use, powerful, and elegant.

ScriptTap uses Android AccessibilityService to execute deterministic, user-created automation scripts, including taps, gestures, navigation, and interaction with exposed UI elements. Automation runs only when the user starts it and can be stopped at any time. Accessibility data is processed on the device and is not collected or shared by ScriptTap.
